culprit_citations.quoted_text: Amergin Asset Management, LLC(23)(25) | Class A Units | N/A | N/A | 50,000,000 | $ | 1 | $ | 1,816

findings.detail: The X07 non-equity scope is wrong for this row: the source places Amergin Asset Management, LLC under Equity Investments and describes the investment as Class A Units, while the source cost of 1 and fair value of 1,816 match the extracted cost 1000 and implied fair value 1816000 in dollars.

rationale: Class 2 within-row review. The raw SOI row is under the Equity Investments section and identifies the security as Class A Units with N/A interest and maturity. The disclosed cost is 1 and fair value is 1,816 in a dollars-in-thousands schedule, so the extracted cost/fair value relationship is source-supported; the real defect is that the row entered the non-equity X07 scope rather than being treated as equity.
